data.body:
## Review fixture

This synthetic draft exists only in the disposable Stage 14 studio checkout. It is not a published portfolio project.

## Content structure

- Long collection titles and descriptive summaries
- A private managed image from a committed sample asset
- Draft and published state controls

## Reading sample

A comfortable authoring interface keeps the current document, its publication state, and its next action understandable. This paragraph supplies enough text to inspect the editor and draft preview without introducing private content.
